note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground and day-use area on the north shore of Bear Lake, on a dry forested rise amid marsh and bog. A few sites sit on open grass near the sandy shore. The day-use area has a swimming beach, dock, boat access and a picnic shelter. Managed by Scenic State Park. --Claude
summary: DNR facility record read: 27 sites (was 29, derived), primitive (no hookups), vault toilets + water, FCFS with same-day online payment ($17 incl. tax; 'pay on site' was wrong). No season stated. Lakeview kept; possible lakefront sites flagged. Website link and phone need updating.
flags: PHONE: none -> 218-571-2600 (Scenic State Park, named as manager on the DNR facility record).

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept, with a possible lakefront upgrade for the reviewer. On current zoom-19 imagery two occupied units sit on open grass about 15-30 m from the sandy shore with nothing but grass and sand between them and the water: one about 47.6772,-93.2660 (about 16 m) and one about 47.6778,-93.2667 (about 28 m, a few scattered trees). They are on spurs off the campground loop, east of the day-use clearing, so they look like campsites rather than day-use parking. All sites are sold by the night (first come, first served). DNR publishes no site map for Bear Lake, so no site numbers can be named. The earlier evidence called the open apron day-use; the imagery suggests at least the eastern part is campsite ground. The DNR text says 'the deciding factors are privacy and proximity to the lake.'
Sites: DNR says 27 campsites (2 accessible), against the stored 29 (derived from note prose). Corrected to 27.
Pin 47.67730,-93.26590 is on the shore edge of the campground, about 70 m from the DNR point 47.677866,-93.266278. No move needed.
Forest alert (2026-05-19): 'South Lofgren Road - Closed due to flooding'. This was not checked against the campground's access route; the DNR campground record carries no closure.
Note cleaned: dropped the site count, hookup/facility list and 'Pay on site' (wrong: DNR no longer takes payment at the campground).
